latest_release.name: Lichii nx2 build 410 (fdc7cda)
latest_release.body:
## Changes since build 386

Built from nx2 at `fdc7cdaf8df179775685d0afb57fca178f876a51`.

Players reported better performance in parts of Ocarina of Time and Donkey Kong Bananza, and smoother crowds in Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave. Gains vary by scene, hardware, and settings.

### Game fixes

- Fix a launch crash in Kirby and the Forgotten Land's Nintendo Switch 2 Edition on affected AMD GPUs. Lichii restores geometry bindings if Vulkan starts a new command buffer while preparing a draw. [#2539](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2539)
- Fix black or incorrectly colored terrain and objects in Ocarina of Time on NVIDIA GTX 10-series and older cards using NVIDIA's driver. The first launch after updating may take longer while the driver rebuilds its shader cache. [#2542](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2542)
- Correct the color grading in Xenoblade Chronicles 2 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition by reading its 3D color lookup textures in the layout the game requests. Based on work by LukeWarnut and Mcm190. [#2435](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2435)
- Use lower-detail lightmaps in Mario Kart World if neither a full Vulkan allocation nor usable sparse residency is available. The fallback keeps all lightmap layers. Adapted from Eglantine work by Sssnowyyy and snowstormxd. [#2459](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2459)
- Enable texture write-backs and reloads for Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition to address garbled loading text in Waddle Dee Town. The Switch 1 edition is unchanged. [#2452](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2452)
- Fix local wireless broadcasts in multiplayer rooms when the host adapter uses a single-address subnet, as with some VPNs. This addresses a disconnect in Mario Kart World room play and leaves direct LAN unchanged. Thanks to thatrandomalt. [#2418](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2418)

### Mods and desktop

- Archive build 386 in What's New and show the new highlights after updating. [#2582](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2582)
- Add **View → Preserve Window Size Across Sessions** to keep the saved window size when a game starts. It's off by default and doesn't change the reset-size presets or fullscreen behavior. Thanks to Størm and DuskDarf1. [#2551](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2551)
- Keep Mod Store results from jumping when you click a partly visible entry or move the pointer with the button held down. Wheel and keyboard scrolling still work. [#2440](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2440)
- Serve Mod Store catalog pages and search results from memory so they don't queue on database reads under load. This is a server-side change. [#2439](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2439)
- Restore PNG thumbnails and full-size screenshots in the emulated Album. [#2498](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2498)
- Prevent a crash when repeated exit requests start overlapping shutdowns after you stop a game or an applet. Based in part on Spotlight's shutdown fix. [#2502](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2502)
- Preserve Build IDs when editing the name, version or icon of affected NUP packages, and block publisher edits that would overwrite an ID. This doesn't repair IDs that were already overwritten. [#2549](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2549)

### Graphics and performance

- Do less work per draw in scenes such as Donkey Kong Bananza's open levels. Avoid rechecking unchanged shader bindings, skip repeated vertex and buffer lookups, and reuse compatible render targets instead of copying them before sampling. Thanks to DuskDarf1. [#2173](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2173) [#2215](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2215) [#2470](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2470)
- Skip camera-data collection and buffer bookkeeping that isn't needed when the experimental render thread is off. Includes compiler-warning fixes from danieljesus. [#2449](https://github.com/zortos293/Lich

detail.readme:
⚠️ Lichii has no official website ⚠️

> [!CAUTION] > **Lichii has no official website.** The only site run by this project is the **game compatibility website, [lichii.zortos.me](https://lichii.zortos.me)**, for compatibility reports only. Download Lichii **only** from this repository's [releases page](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases). Any other "Lichii" website or download (such as lichii.org) is not ours and may contain malware ([#545](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/issues/545)).

# Lichii [![Total downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/zortos293/Lichii/total)](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases) [![Latest release downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/zortos293/Lichii/latest/total)](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases) [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/zortos293/Lichii)](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases) Lichii is an experimental, open-source Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 emulator written in C++. It builds on Eglantine, Eden, yuzu and Sudachi, preserving their contributions while developing this fork's game compatibility and renderer fixes. This is an independent fork, not an official release of those upstream projects. Lichii is not affiliated with Nintendo. Visit the [Lichii game compatibility website](https://lichii.zortos.me) to find games and compare community compatibility reports. ## Downloads and setup Download Lichii only from this repository's [releases page](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases). Lichii has no other download site: archives offered elsewhere, such as lichii.org, are not built by this project, and one has been reported to install malware ([#545](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/issues/545)). Linux ARM64 now ships only the standard AppImage and tarball. If no update appears on an older ARM64 PGO build, download the standard ARM64 package from the releases page. On Windows, extract the entire build archive and run **lichii.exe**. Use homebrew you have permission to run, or your own games and system files dumped from a console you own, where permitted by applicable law. Games, keys and firmware are not included. The project does not provide download sources for them. Owning a console or game does not by itself establish permission to bypass access controls or redistribute its files. ### Existing saves and settings Lichii uses its own profile: `%APPDATA%\lichii` on Windows, and the `lichii` directories under `$XDG_DATA_HOME`, `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME` and `$XDG_CACHE_HOME` on Linux and macOS. Without XDG overrides, these are `~/.local/share/lichii`, `~/.config/lichii` and `~/.cache/lichii`. An existing portable `user/` directory still takes priority and is not imported or changed by the wizard. On the first non-portable GUI launch, Lichii offers to import Eden and other detected emulator profiles. Back up `%APPDATA%\eden` first on Windows, or the old data, config and cache directories on Unix, and close the source emulator. Choose **Keep Old Data** to copy without changing the source, then check your saves and relaunch. Existing destination data is retained in backup directories rather than merged. Move also retains a source backup until you remove it yourself; Link deliberately shares settings and saves. Paths outside the imported data root remain shared and unchanged. An interrupted import offers recovery on the next launch. `eden-cli`, including `--help` and `--version`, refuses to initialize configuration until you import or explicitly choose **Start fresh** in the GUI. ## Compatibility and issue reports Compatibility and performance vary by game, hardware and driver. Rendering errors, stutters and crashes remain possible. Passing automated tests does not establish that a game renders correctly, and this project makes no universal frame-rate guarantee. Browse [community compatibility reports](https://lichii.zortos.me/reports) for results with each player's build and setup. Desktop reporting requires a build containing [PR #303](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/303) and is not available in build 88. In builds that include it, play and stop a Switch 2 game, then right-click that game and choose **Submit compatibility report**. Only the latest session in the current Lichii process is eligible. Confirm the matching website catalog entry and review the editable machine, game, setup, and enabled add-on details prefilled where available. Check the public preview and give explicit consent before submitting. Nothing uploads automatically, and the native v1 reporter does not read or upload logs or files. When [reporting an issue](https://github.com/zortos293/Eglantine/issues), include: - The exact build, game version, CPU, GPU and driver version. - Relevant settings and steps to reproduce the problem. - A screenshot and the log from the affected session, after checking it for personal information. Do not upload game files, keys, firmware or private account information. Bug bundles, GPU traces, shader dumps, pipeline caches and crash dumps can also contain game data. Do not attach them to public reports; ask a maintainer for handling instructions before sharing them. Plain-text logs should be checked for sensitive information before posting. ## Building and contributing See the [build guide](docs/Build.md), [user documentation](docs/user/README.md) and [coding guidelines](docs/Coding.md). Some inherited documentation and internal build target names still use upstream names. The GUI build target is `lichii`; its output is `lichii.exe` on Windows and `lichii` on other desktop platforms. Keep changes focused and distinguish code-level checks from actual gameplay testing. ## Artwork Art created by YOB (yobslab) The supplied Lichii logo, icon and library artwork are in [dist/branding](dist/branding). Windows, Linux and macOS icon resources are generated from that artwork by [Generate-LichiiIcons.ps1](tools/Generate-LichiiIcons.ps1). ## Support Lichii Lichii is free and stays free. If you want to help, you can donate in crypto. Donations help pay for the AI tools and build machines used to develop this open-source project faster. **Solana (SOL)** ```text JepEjfyWjGjhJvHSrqj52KtLjcbbbmUh1iGqerYBF4w ``` **Ethereum (ETH)** ```text 0x055ABa1b80Bc35C836Ce7E9F47c2b3d6C75b5534 ``` **Bitcoin (BTC)** ```text bc1qcvxdpf4qvdhqp8ee4s355cjmxrzsphsdwpl8w4 ``` **BNB Smart Chain (BNB)** ```text 0x055ABa1b80Bc35C836Ce7E9F47c2b3d6C75b5534 ``` **Polygon** ```text 0x055ABa1b80Bc35C836Ce7E9F47c2b3d6C75b5534 ``` Send each coin on its matching network. Coins sent on the wrong network can't be recovered. > [!NOTE] > Donations are voluntary gifts and are non-refundable. A donation does not buy any product, service, perk, early access, exclusive build, priority support or say in the project. Every release stays free and public for everyone. ## Credits and license Lichii inherits the work of the Eglantine, Eden, yuzu and Sudachi projects and their contributors, including Eglantine's original developer Camille LaVey. Upstream attribution and third-party license obligations continue to apply. See [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt) and the source files for applicable license terms.
